name: Arbitrarily-Aligned Plane Visualization
definition: A technique to create images from an arbitrarily-aligned plane by transforming intersected points into a new coordinate system for pixelization, useful for visualizing phenomena not aligned with cardinal axes.
summary: Arbitrarily-Aligned Plane Visualization extracts 2D images from 3D volumes using user-defined planes to reveal off-axis structures that standard axial slicing misses.
